scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -rq dist/tabsum-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json src LICENSE -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.test:browser: TABSUM_HEADLESS=1 sh -c 'node tests/test_hybrid_mode.js && node tests/test_app_ux.js && node tests/test_tab_hardening.js && node tests/test_shortcuts.js && node tests/test_wikipedia.js && node tests/dogfood.js'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node tests/test_core.js && node tests/test_closure_policy.js && node tests/test_storage.js && node tests/test_app_unit.js
